QuestInfo.0: You helped the Novas reach the center of Heliseum.\r\nHelp them reclaim Heliseum entirely.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: You helped the Novas reach the center of Heliseum.\r\nHelp them reclaim Heliseum entirely.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You helped the Novas reclaim Heliseum.\r\nNeinheart finally complimented you for a job well done and said it's time to formally accept you into the Alliance.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: The #bMastermind Magnus#k quest is complete.\r\n(You can start #bNova Troubles#k quest from the lightbulb that appears over your head upon reaching Lv. 102.)

1.msg: It's likely that #bEdea#k will contact you shortly.\r\n

2.msg: The Novas are preparing to retake #bHeliseum#k, but we need you to drive #rMagnus#k away. \r\n(To start, Reach Lv. 102 and accept the #bNova Troubles#k quest using the quest light bulb above your head.)

0.msg: Leave it to me! \r\nI'll go straight to Heliseum as soon as #bEdea#k contacts me.
Are you afraid of #rMagnus#k? I'd hoped I could count on you...
We kicked #rMagnus#k booty all the way out of #bHeliseum#k!\r\nThe dang jerk got away, though...

1.msg: I see...\r\nI suppose I have to congratulate you on a job well done.

2.msg: You did well for yourself.\r\nSpeaking of which...

3.msg: We are taking steps to officially accept you as a member of the Maple Alliance.

5.msg: Have I lied to you yet?\r\nReturn to #bEreve#k when you are ready.\r\nI'll be waiting for you.
